title: [Decision] Previous-major support after 18.0 GA: correct the published N-1 promise to latest-only (A), an on-demand security line for N-1 (B), or a better-auth-style two-branch model (C)?
body:
Ruled: 6328214336 · letter A · 2026-10-21T22:48Z

Filing gate: **② a decision only the maintainer can make.**

- **Filed from** session `session_01GMBuQthe2LLGteJbhzXhvF`, on this request (verbatim): 「我关心的是我们平台是否可以参考类似的规则。立一张决策卡」.
- **Context:** the request followed a reading of how better-auth keeps patching 1.7 while 1.8 is in beta. The better-auth lift that prompted it is #25096.
- ⛔ Not a claim.

**Acting reader:** the maintainer rules. Triage then records the ruling on this card and files the execution named under 裁后执行.

**Dedup** (MCP `search_issues`, closed included):
- objectstack: "maintenance branch backport security fixes to previous major version support window N-1 release line" → 8 hits. None is in scope. The nearest are #22964 and #22933 (docs regime fixes, closed) and #25096 (a dependency lift).
- objectstack: "enter changesets pre mode next tag for v18 major line decision ruling launch window" → 17 hits. The prior rulings are read below.
- cloud: "on-prem ObjectOS EE patch release customers security fix older platform line hotfix" → 0 hits.

**Governing text:**
- `content/docs/protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx:153-159` (Support Windows);
- ADR-0087 D6 (every major goes through the `next` dist-tag for at least one RC cycle before `latest`);
- the board rulings on #15193 and #22050 quoted below.

`node scripts/pm/check-prior-rulings.mjs --terms "backport,maintenance line,support window,LTS,release branch,N-1,pre mode"` finds 0 ADR decisions on these terms.

### 维护者速读

你想参考 better-auth 的做法：新大版本在测试时，旧版本继续出补丁；新版本转正后，旧版本再修几周安全问题。

**矛盾：**
- 10 月 6 日对 17.x 的裁决正好相反：不建维护分支，不建第二条 npm 发布线，cloud 也不钉分支。10 月 7 日又定了不发最后一个 17.x。
- 但公开文档 `/docs/protocol/backward-compatibility` 至今写着：「上一个大版本：只收严重缺陷和安全补丁」。
- 从 8 到 18 的十个大版本里，这个承诺一次都没兑现过。
- 所以无论选哪个字母，这句话都必须改成真话。

**三个选项：**
- **A（推荐）：只支持最新大版本，把文档改成真话。**
  - 文档写明：旧大版本不再收修复，升级走 ADR-0087 的转换层和 `migrate meta`。
  - 一个文档 PR，不加任何流程。
- **B：平时不开维护线，出高危安全修复时临时开。**
  - 只在两个条件同时满足时开：出了高危及以上的安全修复，并且新大版本转正不满 4 周。
  - 做法：从上个大版本最后一个 tag 切分支，移植修复，用 `release-N` 标签发一个补丁版。
  - 要给发版流程加分支触发，并修改 10 月 6 日的两条裁决。better-auth 实际上就是这样运作的。
- **C：照搬 better-auth 的完整双分支模型。**
  - 10 月 6 日已经否决过：main 每天大约 100 个提交，侧分支几天就会烂掉。

推荐 **A**。回一个字母：A / B / C。

如果你知道有付费的 EE 私有化客户停在 17.x、需要安全补丁，请选 **B**。

### 四棱（os-decision-facets）

- ① **项目长远合理性：**
  - A 把向后兼容放在协议里，而不是靠维护多条代码线。ADR-0087 的转换层和可执行迁移，能让晚了三个大版本的应用一次升到最新。这是 Salesforce 式的模型：所有客户在同一版本上，旧契约由平台转换。
  - B 是一个按需开的例外通道，契约增量小，但每次都要人工操作。
  - C 增加一条永久分支和四个工作流。
- ② **实际业务拉动：**
  - 至今没有测到停在 17.x 的 npm 自托管用户。#22050 的置信缺口一直没补上。
  - 唯一可能的拉动是 EE 私有化客户。EE 4.2.0（09-06）跑在 ObjectStack 17.3 上，客户按镜像摘要部署。18.0 转正后，他们拿安全修复只能连带 18 的破坏性迁移一起拿。
  - EE 客户数未知。
- ③ **防 AI 犯错：**
  - 现在文档承诺上一个大版本有补丁，AI 或用户照文档等补丁，会静默落空。A 让文档和行为一致。
  - B 和 C 的移植是人工挑提交，漏掉一个安全修复不会有任何报错。
- ④ **创业阶段不扩散：**
  - A 不增加任何流程。
  - B 增加一条按需发版通道，与「不建议再建立一套 npm 发布流程，我运维太麻烦」冲突。
  - C 增加一条永久分支和四个工作流。

**Prior rulings read:**
- terms `backport,maintenance line,support window,lts,release branch,n-1,pre mode` → 0 ADR hits; ADR-0087 D6;
- thread: none (this is a new card);
- board rulings: #15193 `6017499711` → `6018081901` → `6018207607`, and #22050 `6037890422`.

## 一句话问题

公开文档承诺「上一个大版本只收严重缺陷和安全补丁」，但旧大版本从来没收到过一个补丁。停在上一个大版本的自托管或 EE 私有化客户，要拿安全修复，只能连同下一个大版本的破坏性迁移一起接受。

我们是像 better-auth 那样继续给上一个版本线出补丁，还是把承诺改成「只支持最新大版本」？

## Facts (read at this write, `origin/main` 1862d8d)

### 1. The published promise

`content/docs/protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx:158` reads: "Previous MAJOR (N-1) | **Maintenance** | Critical bug fixes and security patches only".

No other page states a support window.

Re-check:
```sh
git grep -n -iE "End of Life|security patches only|support window" origin/main -- content skills README.md
```
This prints only this page's lines.

### 2. The rulings it contradicts

All are on #15193, from the triage seat's chat with the maintainer.

- **`6017499711`**: 「同意分支模型」. This agreed a `release/17.x` maintenance line, for security and release-blocking fixes only.
- **`6018081901`**, amending it the same day: 「不建议再建立一套 npm 发布流程，我运维太麻烦」. The result: no 17.x npm lane.
- **`6018207607`**: 「cloud 也不需要钉分支」. The result: no 17.x maintenance line of any kind.
  - It also says a branch can be cut later from the recorded pre-v18 commit "if an emergency ever needs one. That is an option, not a plan."
- **`6037890422`** on #22050 ruled **B**, with no last 17.x: 「我建议直接启动 v18 开发吧」.
  - It followed the maintainer's cost reading in `6030429903`: 「发版本的流程还是挺折腾的，发了还要写 17.8 的说明」.

### 3. What npm shows

No version line of `@objectstack/spec` or `@object-ui/core` has ever published again after a newer line shipped.
- spec ran majors 8 → 18 between 2026-06-07 and 2026-10-20.
- 17.7.0 (2026-10-06) is the last 17.x.
- `18.0.0-next.0` to `next.5` went to `next` between 10-13 and 10-19.
- `18.0.0` went to `latest` on 10-20.

Re-check:
```sh
for p in @objectstack/spec @object-ui/core better-auth; do printf '%s: ' "$p"; curl -s "https://registry.npmjs.org/$p" | jq -r '.time | to_entries[] | select(.key | test("^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$")) | "\(.value) \(.key)"' | sort | awk '{split($2,v,"."); print v[1]"."v[2]}' | uniq | sort | uniq -d | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done
```
The command prints each version line that published again after a newer line shipped.
- Today it prints nothing for both of ours.
- better-auth is the positive control: it prints `1.4 1.5 1.6 1.7`.

### 4. Why the stable line goes quiet during a prerelease

- `.github/workflows/release.yml:182-185` publishes on push to `main` only.
- While `main` is in pre mode, every release is the next major's prerelease.
- So between 17.7.0 (10-06) and 18.0.0 (10-20), npm `latest` users received no fix at all.

### 5. EE, the only measured candidate for a pull

The cloud repo's tags:

| Tag | Date | What it says |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `ee-v4.1.0` | 08-20 | "first stable on-prem image" |
| `ee-v4.1.1` | 08-24 | A hotfix, shipped by rolling the framework pin forward to `main` `502ff8b` (#11610), not by a backport. |
| `ee-v4.2.0` | 09-06 | "moves onto the ObjectStack 17.3 platform line" |

- Customers deploy by digest: see the `release-objectos-ee.yml` header.
- There has been no EE release since 09-06.
- How many licensed EE customers there are is not measured.

Re-check:
```sh
git -C cloud ls-remote --tags origin 'ee-v*'
git -C cloud show ee-v4.1.1:.objectstack-sha
```

### 6. The reference: what better-auth does (read 2026-10-21)

**Mechanisms:**
- **`main`** is stable 1.7.x, published to `latest`.
- **`next`** carries `1.8.0-beta.N`, in Changesets pre mode with the tag `beta`.
- **`auto-retarget.yml`** moves a PR whose changeset is `minor` or `major` from `main` to `next`.
- **`release.yml`**:
  - opens a `main` → `next` sync PR after every stable release;
  - publishes a `vX.Y.x` branch under the `release-X.Y` dist-tag.
- **`promote.yml`** exits pre mode and opens a `next` → `main` PR.
- **`backport.yml`** cherry-picks labelled PRs onto `vX.Y.x`.

**In practice:**
- `release-1.6` stopped at 1.6.33 on 09-14, four weeks after 1.7.0 (08-18).
- `v1.6.x` took two more fixes (09-16 and 10-14) that were never published.
- The critical GHSA-965c-763c-88jm (all versions below 1.7.7, published 09-30) shipped no 1.6 fix.
- 1.4 and 1.5 ended the same way: 1.4.22 came two weeks after 1.5.0, and 1.5.6 came before 1.6.0.

### 7. What we already share with better-auth, and what we don't

**Shared:**
- a lockstep Changesets `fixed` group: 73 packages against their 22;
- majors through a prerelease tag before `latest` (ADR-0087 D6). Ours runs on `main`, theirs on a branch.

**Different:**
- To keep breaking changes out of the stable line, we refuse a `major` changeset outside pre mode (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs`), where better-auth retargets the PR instead.

**Missing:**
- a stable line that keeps receiving patches while the next major is in prerelease;
- any line for the previous major after GA.

## 选项 × 代价 × 工作量

| 选项 | 做什么 | 客户可感知后果 | 工作量 |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | 把文档的 Support Windows 改成「只支持最新大版本；旧大版本不再收修复，升级走 ADR-0087 的转换层与 `migrate meta`」 | 自托管和 EE 客户读到的是真话：要安全修复就升级，不会再等一个不会来的补丁 | devx 车道 · 1 个文档 PR · 先例 PR #22988（同一页，+18 −16，1 个文件） |
| B | A 的文档改动，加上一条按需的安全线。三个条件同时满足才触发：① 高危及以上的安全修复；② 新大版本转正不满 4 周；③ 有具名用户停在上一个大版本。触发后从上个大版本最后一个 tag 切 `release/N.x`，移植修复，走同一个 `release.yml` 用 `release-N` 标签发补丁版，不打 `latest` | 上一个大版本的用户在新版转正后 4 周内能拿到高危安全修复，不必马上迁移；4 周后同 A | devx 车道 · 2–3 个 PR（`release.yml` 的分支触发与标签、移植规则、文档）· 无先例（#21993 在出 PR 前撤销）· 之后每次触发都要你合并、批准、写说明 |
| C | 照搬 better-auth：大版本在长期 `next` 分支开发，`main` 只收补丁，加上自动改目标分支、发版后自动同步、转正流程、移植工作流 | 同 B，而且新大版本测试期间旧版本照常收补丁 | devx 车道 · 至少 5 个 PR · 无先例 · 常态成本是 main 每天约 100 个提交下的同步冲突，也就是 `6017499711` 否决侧分支模型的理由 |

## 业务含义直译

- **A**：像 Salesforce。所有客户跑同一个版本，旧契约由平台转换兼容，不维护旧版本。
- **B**：像保险的宽限期。换代后给老用户几周、只修安全漏洞，到期就停。better-auth 实际就是这样：1.6 在 1.7 发布约 4 周后停更。
- **C**：像 Node.js 或 GitLab 的长期支持。两条线并行，靠专人或自动化维护。

## 推荐 + 置信缺口

- **推荐 A。**
- **两年后的样子：** 平台的兼容承诺写在协议里。晚了几个大版本的应用，靠 ADR-0087 的转换层和迁移链一次升到最新；安全修复只出在最新大版本上。参照 Salesforce 的单一版本加多版本契约模型，而不是维护多条代码线。
- **不取 B：** 拉动没有测到，而且与 `6018081901`、`6018207607` 冲突。B 真正需要的「从 tag 临时切分支」，`6018207607` 已经保留为「一个选项，不是计划」，选 A 不会失去它。
- **不取 C：** `6017499711` 已经因为主干速度否决了长期侧分支，它的成本是常态的。
- **置信缺口：** EE 私有化付费客户的数量和所在版本没有测过。如果有客户停在 17.x、需要安全修复，B 的拉动就成立，应该改选 B。
- 只看①选 A；②③④ 是否翻转：否。

## 裁后执行

- **A:**
  - Triage files one ① docs card for `content/docs/protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx`. It replaces the Support Windows table with a latest-only statement and links ADR-0087's conversion layer and `objectstack migrate meta`.
  - It is a docs-only PR (`skip-changeset`), the same shape as PR #22988.
  - The releases index is checked for any contrary sentence in the same PR.
- **B:**
  - Triage records the amendment of `6018081901` and `6018207607` here, then files the following.
  - **A `domain:devx` card:**
    - `release.yml` publishes from a `release/N.x` push under the `release-N` dist-tag, never `latest`;
    - publishing keeps the existing human approval;
    - the trigger conditions are written into the workflow header.
  - **A backport-rule card**, for how a fix reaches the branch.
  - **The docs card from A**, but stating the 4-week, high-or-critical window instead.
  - **One cloud card** naming which framework line each EE version tracks.
  - The window length and the severity floor are part of this ruling. The recommended values, if B, are 4 weeks and high or above.
- **C:**
  - It needs an ADR first, because the branch model changes the release contract.
  - Then an epic with one card per workflow: retarget, sync, promote, backport, and the dual-channel `release.yml`.
